Holiday effects of a fitted model

Source: R/lunarcast.R
holiday_effects.Rd

Collects the estimated holiday effects of a [lunarcast()] fit in one data frame: one row per occurrence for two-level effects and one row per holiday for constant effects.

Usage

holiday_effects(object)

Arguments

object

A `lunarcast` object.

Value

A data frame with columns `holiday`, `type` (`"two-level"` or `"constant"`), `event` (occurrence date), `alpha` (effect on the transformed scale), `se` and, when `lambda = 0`, `ratio` (multiplicative effect eαe^{\alpha}eα).

Examples

fit <- lunarcast(sapi, list(adha = holiday_dates("idul_adha")),
                 window = c(-3, 7), effect = "two-level",
                 trend = "stochastic", season = "none")
head(holiday_effects(fit))
#>   holiday      type      event      alpha        se     ratio
#> 1    adha two-level 2004-02-01 -0.2163649 0.1944415 0.8054413
#> 2    adha two-level 2005-01-21  0.1498446 0.1196080 1.1616537
#> 3    adha two-level 2006-01-10 -0.1460362 0.1098109 0.8641265
#> 4    adha two-level 2006-12-31 -0.3566032 0.1997033 0.7000502
#> 5    adha two-level 2007-12-20  0.2302309 0.1068584 1.2588906
#> 6    adha two-level 2008-12-08  0.3004624 0.1069062 1.3504831
